entities.summary: Lee Hyun-jae is a South Korean actor and drummer. He made his acting debut in South Korean television drama High Kick Through the Roof (2009). He featured in the commercially successful Chinese films, Tiny Times 3 (2014) and Tiny Times 4 (2015), and helped him achieve general recognition in China.
